# Vendor facts: vendor and topic

This note feeds the knowledge base. It is NOT the knowledge base: nothing here is shown to users as fact. Only records in `kb/records/`, promoted by a person, are.

## Candidate facts

For each fact: the exact quote, the page it came from and the date. Never write a price, limit, capability or latency number from memory. Draft the record in `kb/proposals/` (`/propose-kb-record <url>`), not here.

## Conflicts on the page

Where the vendor page contradicts itself, say which value was chosen and why (this becomes the record's `curator_note`).
